NONE: A1 at the present time, not in the past or future
現在，此刻，目前
A2 immediately
馬上，立刻
B2 used to express how long something has been happening, from when it began to the present time
至今
› used in stories or reports of past events to describe a new situation or event
（用於描述過去的新情況或新事件）此刻，這時候
› used when describing a situation that is the result of what someone just said or did
（用於描述剛剛所說或所做之事的結果）這樣一來
B2 very soon
很快，不久
› used to introduce a new subject
（用於引出新話題）接著要談
› used in statements and questions to introduce or give emphasis to what you are saying
（用於陳述句和疑問句，引導後面的話或對其加以強調）
› the present moment or time
現在，此刻
› from this moment and always in the future
從現在開始
B2 used to give an explanation of a new situation
既然，由於

example: She used to be a teacher, but now she works in publishing.
她過去曾是一名教師，但現在從事出版工作。
I may eat something later, but I'm not hungry now.
我過一會兒可能會想吃點兒東西，但現在不餓。
Many people now own a smartphone.
如今許多人都擁有智慧型手機。
I don't want to wait until tomorrow, I want it now!
我不想等到明天，我現在就要！
She's been a vegetarian for ten years now.
她吃素已經十年了。
It was getting dark now, and we were tired.
這時候天越來越黑，我們疲憊不堪。
Oh yes, now I know who you mean.
哦，是的，這樣一來我就知道你指的是誰了。
The guests are coming any minute now, and the house is still a mess.
我們的客人馬上就要到了，可家裡還是亂糟糟的。
And now for what we're going to do tomorrow.
現在我們來討論一下明天要做甚麼。
Now, where did I put my hat?
唉，我把我的帽子放哪裡了？
There was a knock at the door. Now Jan knew her mother had promised to come by, so she assumed it was her.
有人敲門。簡知道媽媽答應過要來，所以認為敲門的是她。
Hurry, now, or you'll miss the bus!
快點，否則你就趕不上公車了！
Sorry, I can't today. Now if you'd asked me yesterday, I would have said yes.
抱歉，我今天不行。如果你昨天問我的話，我會說行的。
Now isn't a good time to speak to him.
現在不適合跟他談話。
I thought you'd be finished by now.
我以為你現在該完成了。
You should have mentioned it before now.
你本該之前就提到它。
That's all for now (= until a future point in time).
暫時就這樣吧。
From now on the gates will be locked at midnight.
從現在開始，大門會在午夜上鎖。
Now I have my car, I don't get as much exercise as I used to.
有車之後，我的活動量不如從前大了。
She's enjoying the job now that she's got more responsibility.
因為承擔了更多的職責，所以她很喜歡這份工作。

NONE: › a negotiable order of withdrawal account: a type of bank account that allows you to take money out at any time and also earns interest
可轉讓提款指令帳戶（一種活期存款帳戶）
› said to attract attention to what you are going to ask or suggest
（引起注意）喂，聽著

example: Now then, what's all this noise about?
喂，這樣大驚小怪的是為甚麼呢？

NONE: › said when someone makes a suggestion or offer that is better than one that they have already made
這下你說對了；這個建議可真是不錯
› said when you want to make someone feel better or give someone a gentle warning
（用於安慰）好了，好了；（用於委婉的警告）行了，行了

example: Now, now, don't cry.
好了，好了，別哭了。
Now, now, children, there's no need to fight!
行了，孩子們，別打了！

NONE: B1 at the present time, in comparison to the past
如今，現在

example: Who remembers those movies nowadays?
如今誰還記得那些電影？
Nowadays, I bake my own bread rather than buy it.
現在，我自己烤麵包而不去買現成的了。

NONE: B1 in, at, or to no place; not anywhere
任何地方都不；無處
› UK not in a successful or winning position
不成功；名落孫山

example: These young people have nowhere (else) to go.
這些年輕人無處可去。
Nowhere does the article mention the names of the people involved.
這篇文章中並未提及相關人員的名字。
The horse I bet on finished nowhere.
我下注的那匹馬沒有獲勝。

NONE: › impossible to see or find
不可能看見（或找到）的

example: We looked for her everywhere, but she was nowhere to be found.
我們到處找她，但哪裡也找不到。

NONE: › nothing
沒有甚麼；無（同 nothing）

example: That's got nowt to do with it!
那與它毫無關係！

owt
